content:
iPhone 18 Pro and the iPhone Fold are just weeks away from launch, with Apple making intensive preparations internally. According to Bloomberg, Apple will hold a lottery for US retail store employees, with winners being sent to California to assist with the September iPhone launch event.

The iPhone launch event is tentatively scheduled for September.

The report states that Apple Store retail employees can apply to participate in the iPhone launch event, where they will be responsible for "assisting with queue arrangements, registering attendees, hosting guests, providing directions, and supporting the security team".

Apple announced the lottery arrangement in an internal memo today, noting that the event will be held in early September.

The memo mentioned that Apple is "honoured to provide US store team members with the opportunity to participate in the event support experience programme". For many years, Apple has relied on retail employees to help coordinate major product launch events. The memo also noted that employees who participated in this year's Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) or last year's iPhone launch event will not be eligible to apply for this programme. Interested employees must submit their applications by August 8, and Apple will notify selected applicants on August 17.

Apple traditionally holds its annual iPhone launch event during the second week of September each year. Since this year US Labor Day falls on September 7, Bloomberg therefore believes "the event is more likely to be held on a Wednesday, as this preserves the weekday travel time Apple has historically provided for attendees".

If this is the case, the iPhone launch event will be held on Wednesday, September 9, with pre-orders expected to begin that Friday and the product officially going on sale a week later.
